memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports mild dyspnoea on climbing two flights of stairs; manages bus route with occasional shortness of breath; ADLs independent.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (negative); no immediate concern for dementia.
falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal).
medicines: 5 regular (tiotropium OD, salbutamol SOS, budesonide-formoterol BD, betahistine BD, melatonin HS); polypharmacy – please review against Beers criteria.
mood: Denies low mood or anxiety; PHQ-2 not performed today.
carers: Daughter Priya, lives with patient.
goal: "I want to keep driving my school bus and stay independent."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
tiotropium inhaler 18 mcg OD
salbutamol inhaler 100 mcg SOS
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler 2 puffs BD
betahistine 16 mg BD
melatonin 3 mg HS

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Spirometry: FEV1 1.68 L (55% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.62
SpO2 room air 94%
TSH 2.1 mIU/L (0.35-4.50)
Haemoglobin 12.8 g/dL (12.0-15.5)

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Chest X-ray: Hyperinflated lungs, flattened diaphragms, no acute infiltrate. Consistent with COPD.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Dix-Hallpike test: Positive on right side; vertigo and nystagmus elicited. Audiometry: Bilateral mild high-frequency hearing loss, otherwise normal.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment scheduled for 2025-08-15 at 10:30 AM with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06).
